# AccordionSummary

Summary for Accordion

## Overview

- **Category**: surfaces
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: AccordionSummary

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { AccordionSummary } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<AccordionSummary expandIcon={<ExpandMoreIcon />}>
  <Typography>Summary</Typography>
</AccordionSummary>
```

## Examples

```tsx
<AccordionSummary expandIcon={<ExpandMoreIcon />}>
  <Typography>Summary</Typography>
</AccordionSummary>
```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's AccordionSummary.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:
